svg.title: Native static export formats
svg.desc: 2026-10-18 · macOS arm64 · dense public MinION input · 87 figures across two runs + pooled report Wall time and RSS cover the whole CLI; size excludes JSON/HTML. One execution per format. PDF retains vector content; PS is raster-backed at 300 DPI. JPEG is lossy; BMP is uncompressed.
